failure_class.instructions: Classify the failed check described in `failure` (command, exit status, smallest relevant error, changed files) into the single most likely class. The classes are defined in docs/05_WORKFLOW.md section 5.

criteria.IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE: Product behavior differs from what the requirement expects
criteria.REGRESSION_FAILURE: Behavior that passed before this change now fails
criteria.BUILD_OR_TYPE_FAILURE: A compile, type, vet, lint or format gate fails because of repository source code (for example an undefined name or type error in a changed file)
criteria.SECURITY_FAILURE: A security criterion or fail-closed rule fails, or a scan reports a reachable vulnerability
criteria.RESOURCE_FAILURE: A leak, missing cleanup, race, lifecycle problem or resource bound fails
criteria.TEST_FAILURE: A deterministic functional test fails and none of the more specific classes fits
criteria.FLAKY_OR_NONDETERMINISTIC: The same unchanged state gives different results across runs
criteria.ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED: No approved capable environment, tool, package version or hardware is available, so the check could not really run
criteria.SANDBOX_INFRA_FAILURE: The sandbox cannot start even a minimal process; the repository check never ran
criteria.SANDBOX_CAPABILITY_LIMITATION: Ordinary commands run locally, but the local sandbox or toolchain cannot perform a step the check needs (for example spawning child processes, or cgo object files that cannot be parsed) while the same code builds in CI or no repository file changed
criteria.UPSTREAM_BLOCKED: An external service (Anime1, AniList, Bangumi, GitHub) prevented a required live check
criteria.SPEC_AMBIGUITY: The requirement is too vague to decide the correct behavior
criteria.SPEC_OR_TEST_CONFLICT: A test or criterion contradicts the documented requirement
criteria.ARCHITECTURE_CONFLICT: A correct fix needs a change to an architectural decision
criteria.VERIFIER_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: A required check was weakened, bypassed or unexpectedly modified
criteria.EXECUTION_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION: A write or access escaped the allowed repository, credential or remote boundary
criteria.UNKNOWN_FAILURE: The evidence is not enough to tell

product_code_at_fault.instructions: Based on `failure`, is a change to product (non-test) code required to make this check pass correctly?

criteria.false: Only tests, fixtures, environment or configuration are involved, or it cannot be told
